references.text: Dor is mentioned as one of the cities whose king fought against the Israelites and was defeated by Joshua.
Dor and its villages are listed as part of Manasseh's inheritance, confirming the geographical location of Dor.
Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Dor, showing that the area remained partially unconquered after the conquest.
Naphath-Dor is mentioned as a district under Solomon's rule, highlighting the region's continued significance in Israel's history.
Gilgal was the place where the Israelites were circumcised and the reproach of Egypt was rolled away, an important site during the conquest.
The kings of the nations are mentioned in connection with the kings whom Abraham fought against, showing early use of the title 'king of the nations'.
